mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, we are looking at 64 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a waning gibbous moon above.

The City of Verona has announced a road surface treatment project starting August 4 on Lincoln Street and near Range Trail, so please watch for parking restrictions. Additionally, residents can earn a 100 dollar rebate for installing high-efficiency toilets through the city's utility program.

There is a busy weekend ahead with the Remote Area Medical clinic taking place today at Verona Area High School. You can also enjoy live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, and don't forget that yoga classes are scheduled for tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
Looking at the weekly report, on Monday, July 21, a Verona Police Department drone officer assisted the Dane County Sheriff's Office in locating a person who had fled from a residence.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM to serve you. If you are already looking ahead, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
